title: An Evolutionary Psychologist's Take On Broken Dating Markets (Ft Geoffrey Miller)
uploader: Based Camp with Simone & Malcolm Collins
description:
Join us in this exciting episode of Based Camp where we welcome esteemed guest, Malcolm and evolutionary psychologist Geoffrey Miller. The conversation dives deep into the challenges of the modern dating market, the impact of dating apps, and the shifting norms on college campuses. Geoffrey shares intriguing insights from his experiences with university students, his thoughts on cultural and societal impacts on dating, and offers practical advice for parents on how to support their children in finding long-term partners. The discussion also touches on the future implications of AI in romantic relationships and the importance of maintaining close family ties. Don’t miss it!

00:00 Introduction and Poll Results
00:25 Welcoming Jeffrey Miller
00:51 The Broken Dating Market
01:29 Campus Dating Policies
03:19 Dating App Frustrations
04:43 The Trad Movement
12:58 Personality Disorders in Dating
15:37 Dating Apps and Passport Wives
23:25 Keeper: A New Dating App
31:13 Finding Love Through CrossFit
31:46 Arranged Marriages and Matchmaking
33:04 Parental Involvement in Dating
35:11 Integrating Family in Modern Dating Apps
36:40 Cross-Cultural Differences in Spouse Vetting
37:31 Teen Marriages and Parental Guidance
44:08 AI Boyfriends and Girlfriends: A New Challenge
49:44 Preparing Kids for Future Mate Choices
51:36 Closing Thoughts and Personal Anecdotes
